verdict.line: You lose if you let Riven farm to a maxed Conqueror proc and free-cast her full Q-W combo while your Fury sits banked; you win if you spend Fury the instant it crosses 50 to chain empowered W stuns into Q bursts.

brief.thesis: Renekton's whole trade pattern hinges on the 50 Fury threshold: above it, W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a 3-hit that strips shields and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s, and Q (Cull the Meek) hits harder and heals more. Riven's threat scales with her own resource — Runic Blade charges from landing abilities, plus stacked Conqueror — and her E (Valor) lets her block a chunk of your damage mid-engage. At 53.8% over 1077 games with lane and solo-kill advantage, this is a matchup Renekton is supposed to win, provided he dumps Fury off cooldown rather than hoarding it.

theirWindow.when: Riven fully stacked with Q charges and E up
theirWindow.what: She can all-in with the full Broken Wings (Q) combo into Ki Burst (W) for the stun, using Valor (E) to soak part of your damage mid-fight. Don't force a trade into a fresh E — wait for her to spend it first.

yourWindow.when: Your Fury is above 50 with W/E off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and open with the empowered W for the 1.5s stun and shield-strip, then follow with the boosted Q for the extra damage and heal. This is the exact window OP.GG's own data flags: use abilities the moment Fury is full instead of sitting on it.

playing.title: Engage after her third Q charge
playing.detail: Riven's Q (Broken Wings) has three charges on a 13s cooldown as a set; once she's burned all three without a takedown reset, walk up and start your empowered combo before she has a dash back.

playing.title: Wait out her Valor
playing.detail: E (Valor) lets her dash forward while blocking incoming damage. Don't dump your Fury-stacked W into a fresh Valor cast — bait it or wait for her to have used it already.

playing.title: Play safe before level 3
playing.detail: Before your W and E are past rank one, Riven's Q-W stun chain plus early Conqueror procs can out-damage you. Farm with auto-attacks and Q pokes only until you hit level 3.

playing.title: Spend Fury, don't bank it
playing.detail: The moment Fury crosses 50, both Q and W upgrade meaningfully. Use them off cooldown at that threshold instead of waiting to stack more — this is the exact behavior OP.GG's data calls out for this matchup.

playing.title: Track her Conqueror stacks
playing.detail: A maxed Conqueror proc spikes her sustained damage and healing hard. If she's fully stacked from farming or poking, shorten your trades or wait for jungle pressure instead of dueling into it.

playing.title: Force fights after level 6
playing.detail: R (Dominus) gives bonus health and periodic Fury generation, letting you win extended fights even against her Blade of the Exile burst. Look to initiate post-6 rather than play passive.

playing.title: Land empowered E for the shred
playing.detail: The second cast of E (Slice and Dice) reduces the Armor of units it hits. Weave it into your all-in combo so the follow-up empowered W and Q land harder.
